cat > /app/tmp/t/test_limits.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from run import run_json
ok = True
CFG = {"early": False, "overlap": "reject", "buffer_packets": 2, "idle_ms": 0,
       "max_streams_bidi": 4, "max_streams_uni": 4, "max_stream_data": 32,
       "max_data": 64, "crypto_limit": 32, "sent": {"I": [], "H": [], "A": []}}
def tick(t): return {"t": t, "op": "tick"}
def dg(t, size, pkts): return {"t": t, "op": "datagram", "bytes": size, "packets": pkts}
def pkt(level, pn, auth, frames): return {"level": level, "pn": pn, "auth": auth, "frames": frames}
def PAD(): return {"type": "PADDING"}

def run(name, doc, want_error=False):
    global ok
    rc, out, err = run_json(doc)
    got = json.loads(out) if rc == 0 else None
    if want_error:
        good = got == {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"}
    else:
        good = isinstance(got, dict) and "results" in got and len(got["results"]) == len(doc["traces"])
    print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ") + name, "" if good else repr(got)[:200])
    ok &= good

# exactly 32 traces
run("32 traces", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t%d"%i,"config":CFG,"events":[]} for i in range(32)]})
# exactly 20000 events
run("20000 events", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":[tick(0)]*20000}]})
# exactly 20000 packets (20000 datagram events of 1 packet)
run("20000 packets", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t","config":CFG,
    "events":[dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",i,True,[PAD()])]) for i in range(20000)]}]})
# exactly 60000 frames: 20000 packets x 3 frames
run("60000 frames", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t","config":CFG,
    "events":[dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",i,True,[PAD(),PAD(),PAD()])]) for i in range(20000)]}]})
# exactly 2 MiB decoded data: 1024 frames of 2048 bytes
big = "ab"*2048
evs = []
for i in range(64):
    evs.append(dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",j,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":big} for j in range(16)]) for j in range(1)]))
# 64 events x 1 packet x 16 frames x 2048 bytes = 2097152
run("2MiB data exact", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t",
    "config":dict(CFG, crypto_limit=65536),
    "events":evs}]})
# 2 MiB + 1 byte -> invalid
evs2 = evs + [dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"ab"}])])]
run("2MiB+1 data", {"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"t","config":dict(CFG, crypto_limit=65536),"events":evs2}]}, want_error=True)
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_limits.py 2>&1 | tail -8
